# dsh-session-recycle-bin
**Session recycle bin & permanent delete for DeepSeek Harness.**
Move the current session into a recycle bin from the conversation header, restore or permanently del
ete archived sessions (single or batch), with live-session protection.

The interface automatically follows the browser language: Chinese locales use
Chinese and all other
locales use English.
English | 中文
## ✨ Features
- **Conversation-header archive button** — move the current session into the recycle bin from the he

ader (no confirmation; always recoverable).
- **No duplicate of DSH's own affordance** — archiving f
rom the sidebar uses DSH's built-in hover button; this plugin no longer injects a second, differentl
y worded icon (0.4.4 removed the old row trash icon and the document-wide MutationObserver that drov

e it).
- **Recycle-bin manager** (Settings → 🗑 会话回收站) — archived sessions with multi-select: batch r

estore, batch permanent delete; each item shows its ID and path.
- **True permanent delete** — physi
cally removes the session log from disk and the projection-cache record; ghost sessions (records wit

hout a log) are cleaned up so they vanish instead of lingering.
- **Live-session protection** — sess

ions with an active agent are refused deletion.
- **Sub-session aware** — each row can show how many
sub-agent sessions it left behind (whole tree, any depth) and open them inline: title, size, time a
nd running state, with a checkbox per sub-session. Permanent delete removes the whole tree; the ones
you uncheck are kept and stay reachable as a "deleted main session · N sub-sessions kept" row inste

ad of becoming invisible leftovers.
- **Running sub-agents block the row** — a session is refused wh

ile any sub-session in its tree is still running, and the refusal names it.
- **Batch fault toleranc

e** — batch operations delete per-session with error collection and reporting.
- **Light/dark adapti
ve UI** — all colors are CSS custom properties in `client.css`; components follow the resolved DSH a
ppearance (`data-ds-dark-theme`) with `prefers-color-scheme` as the OS-level fallback (no hardcoded
palette). UI and code text follow the app font too (`--dsw-font-family` / `--ds-font-family-code`),
so the Settings → 字体 choice applies here as well.
## 📋 Requirements
- **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer** (this release is tested on that version only; older hosts are untested
**DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer** (this release is tested on that version only; older hosts are untested).
The recycle-bin list no longer reads session logs: its titles and turn counts come from the Session
projection cache (`SessionProjectionCache.cachedSnapshot`, plus `cachedPredecessorTitle` for checkpo
ints written by an older format generation) — the same zero-I/O face DSH's own session list uses. On
a host without those two methods the plugin still mounts, archives and restores, but the list degra
des to 「未命名会话」 with no turn counts.
The floor is declared as `dsh.engines.dsh`. Note that DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 does **not** read that field: i
t is documentation for users and marketplaces, not a runtime gate.

## 🚀 Usage
1. **Move to the recycle bin** — click the 「移入回收站」 icon in the conversation header: the session is a
rchived and an undo toast appears. Whether an archived session keeps showing in the left sidebar is
decided by DSH's own **View options → Filter sessions** setting (Hide archived / All conversations /

Archived only); this plugin does not touch it, exactly like DSH's built-in archive button.
2. **Set

tings recycle bin** — open **Settings ⚙️ → 🗑 会话回收站**:
- Checkbox multi-select → **Restore** (batch u

narchive) or **Permanent delete** (batch purge).
- Each entry shows the session name, ID and working

path (hover for full details).
3. **Permanent delete** physically removes the log and projection ca

che; live sessions are protected.
4. **Undo** — restoring shows an undo toast that re-archives the s

ve sessions are protected.
4. **Undo** — restoring shows an undo toast that re-archives the session.

### Changelog convention
`CHANGELOG.md` and `CHANGELOG.zh.md` mirror each other. Every entry follows:
- Version section `## [version] - YYYY-MM-DD`, with only the `### Added` / `### Changed` / `### Fixe

d` / `### Performance` / `### Removed` headings it actually uses.
- One topic per bullet: **a short

bold lead stating the outcome**, then 1-2 sentences on what changed and why it matters.
- No impleme

ntation detail, no code, no test or verification results — those belong in the commit or the PR.
- W
rite only user-visible or breaking changes; skip internal refactors with no visible effect.
## 🔌 How it works
- A **single npm bundle** covers both halves, same as other published plugins: the host row mounts v
ia `cordis.patch.yml`; the browser half joins automatically through `dsh.client` + `exports["./clien

t"]`.
- The browser talks to the host over the plugin's own `/api/session-trash/*` HTTP routes (regi
stered on the webserver; non-GET requests carry an `x-dsh-plugin` CSRF header).
